payload.reason: The evidence provides details on the feature extraction process used to incorporate cluster membership features, which is relevant to understanding how clusters were extracted.

claims.text: Clusters were extracted by incorporating cluster membership features into the feature extraction pipeline, which included n-gram features and sentiment scores.
The feature extraction process involved filtering results using an English vocabulary and removing hashtags to improve cluster quality.
The study suggests that using out-of-domain data, such as Wikipedia articles, is beneficial for constructing word embeddings used in clustering.
